presets.name: MP4 · H.264
presets.description: Compatible MP4, high quality, original resolution. First video and all audio tracks; subtitles are omitted.

presets.name: MP4 · H.264 · up to 1080p
presets.description: Smaller MP4 for sharing. Downscales larger video, never upscales. First video and all audio tracks; subtitles are omitted.

presets.name: WebM · VP9 · up to 1080p
presets.description: Efficient web video. Slower encoding; first video and all audio tracks, without subtitles.

presets.name: MKV · AV1 · balanced
presets.description: Smaller-file option using 10-bit software AV1 and Opus audio, at original resolution. Encoding takes longer; savings depend on the source. First video and all audio tracks; subtitles are omitted.

presets.name: MKV · AV1 · compact · up to 1080p
presets.description: More aggressive compression, capped at 1080p without upscaling. Uses 10-bit software AV1 and Opus; trades some quality for size. First video and all audio tracks; subtitles are omitted.

presets.name: MKV · copy all tracks
presets.description: Fast remux without re-encoding. Keeps video, audio, subtitles, chapters and attachments supported by Matroska.

presets.name: Extract audio · M4A / AAC 192 kbps
presets.description: Extracts the first audio track to an M4A file. The source video is kept.
